test_status: Previously observed dates; exploratory comparison, NOT fresh untouched holdout.
label_policy: Mask each unavailable label independently; every training label ends strictly before split. No labels used for input normalization.
target_scale_policy: Fixed 0.01*sqrt(h); equal mean absolute scaled error across the five heads. No future-fitted scale.
screening: For each architecture compare 3 lookbacks over the same eligible origins and 3 development windows using seed1. Choose lowest equal-fold/equal-index/equal-horizon scaled MAE. No test scores inspected.
replication: Repeat the chosen lookback in all 3 development folds with seed2. Ensemble both seeds. Refit holdout/latest using rounded median of six validation-selected epoch counts.
selection: Per index/horizon choose lowest ensemble validation MAE among four architectures; >=1% gain vs best of current selected validation MAE, zero and matched historical mean is a research eligibility gate. No automatic daily deployment.
pooling: One shared five-output network across8 indices, with an index-ID embedding. Daily prices aggregated into nonoverlapping five-session OHLCV blocks; first block may be shorter.
origins: All lookbacks share origins with complete maximum1260+1-session history for each index. Training minibatches take every5th observed exchange origin; validation reports and test use daily origins.

architecture_spec.tcn: 8 channels,8 causal kernel3 residual blocks with dilations1..128,receptive field511 blocks,dropout0.1
architecture_spec.patchtst: 8-block patches (about40 sessions),8-dimensional embedding,2 heads,1 encoder layer,FF16,dropout0.1; channel-independent encoder and learned channel mixing
architecture_spec.linear: Shared temporal projection per channel, learned channel mixing; DLinear7-block moving average; NLinear removes last block without price-level addition to return head

limitations: Previously observed test dates: exploratory only
Two seeds, fixed small CPU budget; no exhaustive hyperparameter search
Historical index backfill and correlated overlapping labels remain
These are adapted architecture implementations, not exact upstream benchmark reproductions
